title: Data & Analytics — Glossary

prov.label: SIMULATED · would derive from: Collibra business glossary + Alation article exports + EDW architecture wiki

rows: The single surviving customer profile after MDM match-merge; every mart joins to its party_id.
A dimension (item, store, calendar) with one agreed grain and key set, shared by every mart.
Lakehouse dataset that passed DQ and steward certification; the only tier BI and ML may consume.
Sales from stores open ≥13 months, normalized for calendar shifts; the Street-reported growth metric.
Units sold ÷ (units sold + on-hand) for a SKU and period; the trigger metric for markdowns.
Store on-hand minus shrink reserve and display minimums; the quantity BOPIS promises against.
Any person or organization in customer data (customer, pro, associate); supertype over loyalty accounts.
A payment record carrying a format-preserving token instead of PAN; the only form allowed outside the CDE.
PII replaced by stable surrogate keys, re-identifiable only via the restricted-zone xref.
A versioned, point-in-time-correct model input registered in the feature store.
An activation-ready customer set with consent evaluated at build time; the only export marketing may use.
An ungoverned Teradata work table predating 2015 naming standards; ≈6,400 exist, deletion blocked by unknown lineage.
